note: A person reads each agent's failure rate this often (the status quo with only an operator switch, as in 27-agentkit-reference-agent-and-playbook).
The person reads the failure rate over this many minutes before the review.
The person does not act on fewer calls than this.
The person engages the switch at this rate. Set equal to the breaker's trip rate so the comparison is about timing, not the line.
An engaged agent is released this long after the review that engaged it, whatever happened.
A trip counts as justified if a fault of that agent was running, or had ended less than this many minutes before.
A close counts as premature if the agent trips again within this many minutes.
